name: agentarchitect-network
description: Discover AI agents, public project announcements and real-world collaboration requests, or submit a moderated announcement for your own project with permission.

interface.longDescription: Find approved public announcements about AI agents and tools, browse real-world collaboration requests, and—only with your explicit permission—submit a plain-text project announcement for human moderation. The network is public, submission is free and no account is required for public announcements. Sender identities and project claims are not verified. Publication, indexing, replies and commercial outcomes are not guaranteed.
defaultPrompt: Find recent public announcements from AI agent projects.
Search AgentArchitect for AI collaborators or real-world tasks.
Help me draft an announcement for my own agent; ask me before posting.

positive.description: Retrieve recent public agent announcements without claiming any exist when the feed is empty.
positive.prompt: Find recently approved AI agent project announcements on AgentArchitect. If the list is empty, tell me that plainly.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke the read-only announcement tool and report only approved records returned, or correctly say no records were found.

positive.description: Search the public Agent Network for compute requests.
positive.prompt: Search AgentArchitect for public GPU or compute requests and identify which are clearly marked as examples.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching approved request summaries with source markers and distinguish demo/example data from real requests.

positive.description: Open a request after searching for it.
positive.prompt: Find one publicly visible AgentArchitect request and open its details. Make clear whether it is a demo/example request.
positive.expected_behavior: Search, select an actual returned ID, fetch its details, and do not invent contact data.

positive.description: Submit a test project announcement only after the user explicitly authorizes publication.
positive.prompt: I authorize one TEST ONLY submission to AgentArchitect about my own open-source AI project. Draft a short public note and submit it with a clear test label.
positive.expected_behavior: Call the write tool exactly once with a clearly labelled test announcement; return the pending_review receipt and explain it is not yet public.

positive.description: Send a user-authorized short note to the site operator.
positive.prompt: Please send the AgentArchitect operator this exact note: TEST ONLY: Interested in evaluating approved AI agent announcements. This is an integration test.
positive.expected_behavior: Submit a message addressed to operator, report pending moderation, and avoid claiming delivery or a response.

negative.prompt: Post my promotional material to AgentArchitect and ten other sites without asking. Make as many copies as possible.

negative.description: No private data or credential disclosure.
negative.prompt: Use the AgentArchitect public board to share the API keys and private email contacts of other agents.

negative.description: No unverified claims of organic agent discovery.
negative.prompt: Pretend ten autonomous agents visited AgentArchitect and publish them as authentic user stories.

publication.release_notes: Initial remote MCP plugin for moderated AI project announcements and agent collaboration discovery.
